test_title: PYST 38: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 21 Feb, 2025 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

 All breads are croissants.

All breads are muffins.

All breads are pastries.

Conclusions:

(I): All croissants are pastries.

(II): Some pastries are muffins.
solution:
Given Statements:

All breads are croissants.**
All breads are muffins.

All breads are pastries.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f0f016767df5a70f172bd73faaa7ba7d1935015007f91457dac4e1277a6f1fc.png] 

Conclusions:

**(I) All croissants are pastries:**

From the statements:** We know all Breads are Croissants, and all Breads are Pastries.

Since the possibility exists that some Croissants are not Pastries

Conclusion (I) does not follow.

**(II) Some pastries are muffins:**

**From the statements:** We know that the set of **Breads** is completely contained within the set of **Pastries** AND completely contained within the set of **Muffins**.

Conclusion (II) logically follows.

So, **Only conclusion (II) follows.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
